board.ui_unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-avatar-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA cached avatar touchscreen interface
Wants=xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
After=local-fs.target xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
RequiresMountsFor=/home/root/aura-long-conversation-20261019/candidate-9a5bcf476bf8/runtime
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
Environment=DISPLAY=:0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-long-conversation-20261019/candidate-9a5bcf476bf8/runtime/aura
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-long-conversation-20261019/candidate-9a5bcf476bf8/startup/launcher.py --config /home/root/aura-long-conversation-20261019/candidate-9a5bcf476bf8/startup/config.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=25
KillMode=mixed
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=aura-avatar-ui

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target
board.camera_unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-camera-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA shared USB camera preview and YOLOX person adapter
After=local-fs.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-enrollment-photos-20261019/candidate-6f1aa1842d53/runtime/aura/board/vision/ui_camera_service.py --config /home/root/aura-enrollment-photos-20261019/candidate-6f1aa1842d53/camera_live_config/board_camera_ui.json
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-enrollment-photos-20261019/candidate-6f1aa1842d53/runtime/aura
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
